# LRT Oracle Fixture Provenance

Generated by `tools/oracle_lrt.R` (smooth 2x2 batch x condition dataset).

- R version: 4.5.3
- DESeq2 (R): 1.50.2
- BiocParallel (R): 1.44.0
- Seed: 20260614
- Generation date: 2026-06-14
- Environment: WSL conda env `ccdeseq2` (same toolchain as the interaction oracle)

The CSV files were copied from `tools/results/` into this tracked fixture
directory so Windows and Unix CTest runs can validate the LRT pipeline without
invoking R.

To regenerate (requires R + DESeq2), from the repository root:

```bash
Rscript tools/oracle_lrt.R
cp tools/results/oracle_lrt_*.csv tests/fixtures/oracle_lrt/
```

Acceptance thresholds are defined in `tools/oracle_lrt_diff.py`.
